# fundament_project_members (Data Source)

Fetches the list of members for a project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fundament_project" "example" {
  name = "my-project"
}

data "fundament_project_members" "all" {
  project_id = data.fundament_project.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project to list members for.

### Read-Only

- `members` (Attributes List) List of project members. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `created` (String) The timestamp when the member was added.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the project member.
- `permission` (String) The permission of the project member.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project.
- `user_id` (String) The ID of the user.
- `user_name` (String) The name of the user.
